newsitem.title: USA: TeleTech shareholders offer 3.6 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: TeleTech shareholders offer 3.6 mln shares.

text.p: TeleTech Holdings Inc said Thursday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission for its shareholders, including company founder Kenneth Tuchman, to sell up to 3.6 million common shares.

Of the amount, 2,880,000 common shares will be offered in the United States and 720,000 common shares will be offered in the international market. After the offering there will be 55,092,330 common shares outstanding, the filing said.
Tuchman, who is also, chairman of the board, president and chief executive officer, is offering up a substantial number of the shares, the filing said.

The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option to purchase up to 540,000 additional shares of common stock. The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Smith Barney Inc.
